audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1, 4 and 6 of the level chart are inverted against the packet, against this page's own why-strings, and against the mirror.
audit.why: whys[0] says 'both of you are weak at level 1' but the row reads Lillia. whys[1] says 'she spikes at 2' but the row reads Skill. whys[4] says her stun beats your ultimate but the row reads Lillia. whys[6] says you finally out-skirmish her but the row reads Irelia. The prose was right on all four and the enums were wrong; the mirror has already flipped the same four rows on the Irelia page.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Lillia in both layers, with ratings inverted from the mirror's (Level 1 5/10, Level 6 3/10, 2+ items 7/10).

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d invents a 'fifteen-second' Flawless Duet window and nothing else on the page carries a number.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 — 16s at rank 1. Bladesurge is 10s at rank 1 but REFRESHES on a Marked target or a kill, so its real cooldown in a trade is nearly zero. Defiant Dance is 20s at rank 1. Vanguard's Edge is 125s at rank 1, and Lilting Lullaby 150s — she out-cooldowns your ultimate by 25 seconds, which is why trading ults is a losing exchange.
audit.corrected: 16s, the Bladesurge refresh condition, and 125s vs 150s written into the interactions block, the do's, whys[4] and spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings say 'Her R stun' and one says 'her E roots'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Flawless Duet (E) sends two blades that converge — enemies caught between are damaged, STUNNED and Marked. There is no root. Vanguard's Edge (R) fires blades that Mark, then form a wall that DAMAGES AND SLOWS anyone walking through — it does not stun at all. Against a champion whose entire kit is move speed, 'stun' and 'slowing wall you can choose not to cross' are completely different problems.
audit.corrected: Flawless Duet named as the stun, Vanguard's Edge as a Marking blast plus a slowing wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Defiant Dance does not reduce Lillia's damage.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Lillia's damage is magic, plus a TRUE-damage edge on Blooming Blows. So her W charge is free damage for you — the one moment in the lane where standing and hitting her is correct. The mirror found three strings on the Irelia side telling players to soak Lillia's damage with it; on this side the fact is simply absent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings call Ionian Fervor 'passive shred'.
audit.why: Riot's text: striking enemies with spells gives her stacking bonus ATTACK SPEED, and at maximum stacks bonus damage on hit. It shreds nothing — no resistance reduction is involved. The practical advice changes: you are racing her stack count, not her penetration.
audit.corrected: Named Ionian Fervor and described as stacking attack speed into bonus on-hit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Bladesurge/Mark loop is never explained.
audit.why: Riot's text: Bladesurge's cooldown REFRESHES if the target is Marked or dies to it. Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge both apply Mark. That is the actual engine of the matchup — landing E means her dash is effectively free — and the page only ever says 'her Q resets off minions'.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[4], wants.foe[0] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: none of Irelia's abilities were named, and the full layer calls her 'he' and 'his'.
audit.why: Wrong pronouns plus generic 'her Q', 'her E' on a HARD matchup page is the least credible combination on the site.
audit.corrected: Abilities named; pronouns fixed in winCon, report[1].t and dontsFull[0].t.

notes: The eight chart edits (four rows x two layers) plus four ratings are one atomic group; ratings are the inverse of the mirror's (it raised Irelia's Level 1 to 5/10, Level 6 to 7/10 and dropped 2+ items to 3/10). Biggest content correction: Vanguard's Edge does not stun — it Marks and leaves a slowing wall — while Flawless Duet is the stun, and it Marks too, which is what refreshes Bladesurge. That Mark-to-reset loop was never explained anywhere on the page despite being the engine of the matchup. Also added the fact that Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage only, so her charge is a free window for Lillia's magic and true damage — previously absent.
